title: Fix AS scratch buffer usage flags, alignment, and sizing
purpose: Eliminate VUID 03674 and stabilize BLAS/TLAS builds by creating properly flagged and sized scratch buffers and querying required sizes per build.

steps.detail: Use vkGetAccelerationStructureBuildSizesKHR for each BLAS/TLAS build to compute buildScratchSize and updateScratchSize. Round up to required alignment.
Create scratch buffers with VK_BUFFER_USAGE_STORAGE_BUFFER_BIT | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_SHADER_DEVICE_ADDRESS_BIT. Allocate with device-local memory and fetch device address.
Set pInfos[i].scratchData.deviceAddress to the aligned scratch buffer address. Reuse a persistent, max-sized scratch buffer when possible, or suballocate with aligned offsets.
Log scratch sizes (build/update), alignment used, and buffer address per build (BLAS/TLAS).

acceptance: AS builds succeed under stress (5+ rebuilds) without crash
Scratch buffer address and sizes logged
notes: Prefer a single persistent scratch buffer sized for the worst-case build to reduce fragmentation. Ensure alignment via minAccelerationStructureScratchOffsetAlignment.
